# jump game — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> A simple HTML5 canvas-based endless runner game where a blue player character jumps over incoming red monsters using the spacebar. The game features a score counter displayed in Arabic, increasing difficulty as the monster speeds up with each successful dodge, and a game-over alert with score display. The overall vibe is minimal and arcade-style with a sky-blue background.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About jump game
A simple HTML5 canvas-based endless runner game where a blue player character jumps over incoming red monsters using the spacebar. The game features a score counter displayed in Arabic, increasing difficulty as the monster speeds up with each successful dodge, and a game-over alert with score display. The overall vibe is minimal and arcade-style with a sky-blue background.

## Target Audience
- Casual Gamers
- Mobile Game Fans
- School Students

## Industry
Gaming
